## Summary

Describe the paper additions or catalog corrections.

## Evidence

Link primary sources and identify the tables, sections, or appendices supporting quantitative claims.

## Checklist

- [ ] Inclusion criteria are satisfied.
- [ ] The paper is a formally accepted 2026 conference record from a first-party source; arXiv is not the primary source.
- [ ] Claude Code or Codex CLI is actually run or evaluated as a product, not inferred from a model name.
- [ ] Product, model, version, and budget fields are complete or explicitly unknown.
- [ ] Comparability caveats are recorded.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] No paper PDF has been committed.
